hero.purpose: One word per hanging tag in the welcome hero.

display.purpose: Screen and section headings, condensed capitals.

headline.purpose: Sub-section heads, hook and woven labels.

label.purpose: Buttons, chips, tabs, status, stub text.

barcode.purpose: Code 39 rendering of real product codes on tear-off stubs.

shadows.name: tag-hang
shadows.purpose: Filter on every hanging tag so the shadow follows the chamfer and hole.

shadows.name: rail
shadows.purpose: Steel rail cast shadow, over linear-gradient(#d5d9de, #868c93).

shadows.name: eyelet
shadows.purpose: Contact shadow on the nickel eyelet.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for CSS state transitions (flood, tabs, swap, strings).

motion.name: letter-swap
motion.purpose: Hover label swap on tag buttons.

motion.name: tag-drop
motion.value: elastic.out(1, 0.38 to 0.42), 1.5 to 1.7s, from rotation 6 to 16deg

motion.name: tag-sway
motion.value: quickTo rotation, elastic.out(1, 0.3), 1.4s; scroll velocity / 350 clamped to 6deg; pointer contact 5deg
motion.purpose: Every swinging tag reacts to scroll speed and touch.

motion.name: char-reveal
motion.value: SplitText chars masked, yPercent 115, expo.out 0.8 to 0.9s, 14 to 16ms stagger

motion.name: magnetic
motion.value: quickTo x/y 0.5s power3.out, 0.22x / 0.3y of pointer offset
motion.purpose: Primary tag buttons on fine pointers.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all JS motion skipped; CSS durations 0.01ms

components.name: Swing Tag

components.css: :host{--board:#e2e6ea;--card:#fff;--weave:#161616;--thread:#d92128;--cord:#8a9097;--men:#2a46d8;--women:#d6307a;--kids:#ffc21f;--foot:#b78b5a;--ink:#161616;--ink-2:#50555b;--line:#c3c8ce;--on-weave:#f1f3f5;--on-weave-2:#aeb3b9;--sans:"Bricolage Grotesque Variable","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1);--weave-tex:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgb(255 255 255/.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgb(0 0 0/.3) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px);}.ds-swing{--hole:7px;--hole-y:22px;display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;transform-origin:50% 0;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 16px rgb(22 22 22/.15)) drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgb(22 22 22/.12));transition:rotate .6s var(--ease)}.ds-swing:hover{rotate:4deg}.ds-string{position:relative;z-index:1;width:2px;height:51px;margin-bottom:-15px;background:var(--thread)}.ds-tag{position:relative;width:190px;padding:40px 16px 16px;display:grid;gap:4px;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);clip-path:polygon(22px 0,calc(100% - 22px) 0,100% 22px,100% 100%,0 100%,0 22px);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle at 50% var(--hole-y),transparent var(--hole),#000 calc(var(--hole) + .5px));mask:radial-gradient(circle at 50% var(--hole-y),transparent var(--hole),#000 calc(var(--hole) + .5px))}.ds-tag b{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.2}.ds-tag small{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-eyelet{position:absolute;left:50%;top:var(--hole-y);width:22px;aspect-ratio:1;translate:-50% -50%;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid transparent;background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,#f2f4f6,#5d636a,#c9ced3,#3f444a,#f2f4f6) border-box;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.35)}

components.name: Woven Label
components.description: Woven-black strip with weave texture and dashed stitch inset; used for notices, bands and tag headers.

narrative.overview:
Every garment, every step and every finished look is a swing tag: die-cut card stock with chamfered top corners, a punched hole with a nickel eyelet, hanging on a red thread from a steel rail over a cool shop-display board. The tags are the content containers; there are no rounded product cards. Chrome is woven label: near-black ribbon with a fine CSS weave and a dashed stitch line sewn just inside its edge. Department is carried by tag stock colour, the way a shop colour-codes its own tickets.

The type is one family, Bricolage Grotesque, pushed to 800 weight at 75% width and set in capitals for everything that announces, and left at normal width for everything that explains. Display sizes are very large and tightly leaded so a single word can fill a tag. Density is low and targets are large: this is a shop-floor kiosk, so controls sit at 44px minimum and most primary ones at 46 to 58px.

Motion is physical. Tags drop in on elastic easing and settle, sway with scroll velocity, swing when the pointer brushes them, and progress is shown as a running stitch. All of it switches off under reduced motion; the static world still reads completely.
keyCharacteristics: Swing tags on red thread as the universal container, hung from a steel rail.
Woven-black label bands with dashed stitch insets for all chrome.
Department tag stocks: cobalt men, fuchsia women, sun-yellow kids, kraft footwear.
One variable grotesque: 800 condensed capitals for display, normal width for text.
Perforation, tear-off stubs and Code 39 barcodes as functional detail, not decoration.
Elastic, gravity-driven motion with a full reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Red Thread Rule
rules.body: Red is the thread and only what the thread means: hanging, chosen, live, or the one primary action. It is never a section fill, a heading colour or a decorative accent.

rules.name: The Stock Means Department Rule
rules.body: Cobalt, fuchsia, yellow and kraft each belong to one department. Use them for tag stock, the department colour key and the item dot; do not reuse them as status or warning colours.

rules.name: The Cord Turns Red Rule
rules.body: A tag's string is Plain Cord until the item is chosen; choosing it turns the string Red Thread. Selection is shown on the thread first.

rules.name: The Two Postures Rule
rules.body: Condensed 800 capitals announce; normal-width text explains. Never set a paragraph condensed, and never set a heading at normal width.

rules.name: The Real Code Rule
rules.body: The barcode face only ever renders a real product code, sized by container query so the bars fill the stub.

rules.name: The Only Hanging Things Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: A surface casts a shadow because it hangs off the board. Flat controls and bands never get one.

dos: Do hang content on tags: chamfered 22px top corners, punched hole, eyelet, string from a rail.
Do keep Red Thread for strings, chosen and live states, focus and the single primary action per screen.
Do colour by department stock (men cobalt, women fuchsia, kids yellow with ink text, footwear kraft).
Do put chrome on woven black with the weave texture and a dashed stitch inset.
Do set announcements in Bricolage 800 at 75% width in capitals, and explanations at normal width.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and give every motion a reduced-motion path.
donts: Don't use white rounded product cards in a grid under a model-photo hero; that is the category default this world replaces.
Don't use department stock colours as warning or status colours.
Don't add shadows to flat controls or bands; only hanging things cast shadows.
Don't render placeholder or invented codes in the barcode face.
